payload.reason: The evidence provides clear definitions and descriptions of the baseline systems used in the study.

claims.text: The baseline consists of two systems: a traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) system and a neural machine translation (NMT) system.
The training data for the baseline systems includes KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts.
The aim of the baseline systems is to establish reproducible NMT systems for further research.
